verdicts.explanation: The 2.5 μS cm−1 value is the paper's measured conductivity of the amorphous NaTaO3 nanopillar array film, measured at RT in air by AC impedance, and the PLD synthesis matches. Relative density is correctly null because the paper gives only a film density (3.3 g cm−3, ~47% of dense film) and not a relative density value for the record.

The 5 nS cm−1 value is the paper's own measurement of the dense NaTaO3 film, given in the Fig. 2 caption and text, and the Methods say the AC conductivity was measured at RT. Its origin is experimental, not literature_cited, and the low-O2 deposition matches the paper.
